projects.title: Nyumblies
projects.description: Nyumblies are an experiment in artificial ecosystems. By nature ecosystems are a combination of different lifeforms with unique designs, who interact over time to form a dynamic system of life and movement. The Nyumbly ecosystem, Norgamatos, is formed by artistic intervention rather than the gradual process of evolution.  Norgamatos, and the Nyumblies within it, can be viewed at anytime online at axum.graphics/Nyumblies/.  Nyumblies are created with the Nyumbilator: an open online design tool where artists can craft their own Nyumbly lifeforms, define their behavior, and introduce them into Norgamatos. The project was first presented at the 2015 3D Web Festival(http://www.3dwebfest.com/artists.html). For technical details, see the NURDS 3D Blog(http://3d-nurds.blogspot.com/2015/12/nyumblies.html).
